entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: One of the seven continents of Zendikar, where sunlight is obscured by floating hedrons; native home of most of Zendikar's merfolk.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which Tazeem is a continent.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The largest city of Tazeem, built atop an ancient seawall; where the Gatewatch was formed.

entities.name: Halimar
entities.description: A vast, deep artificial inland sea enclosed by cliffs and an ancient seawall.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A plain of floating broken land and hedrons, the remains of the Tazeem Skyclave destroyed by Iona.

entities.name: Makindi Empire
entities.description: The ancient empire of which Tazeem was once part; its reign ended when Iona destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave.

entities.name: Iona
entities.description: An archangel who destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave, creating the Sky Ruin of Emeria.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who took control of Emeria's remnants, secretly benefactor of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, and later compleated.

entities.name: Compleated Nahiri
entities.description: The compleated version of the planeswalker Nahiri who arrived at the Emeria Skyclave during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titanic beings whose release destroyed Sea Gate and killed Oran-Rief.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi titan who blighted the Oran-Rief vastwood.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group formed on a cliffside overlooking Sea Gate, which gave it its name.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker whose use of the Lithoform Core's healing power accelerated Zendikar's recovery.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: A source of healing power used by Nissa Revane to heal the continent.

entities.name: Commander Tazri
entities.description: Drafted her own plan for rebuilding Sea Gate.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: An angel who stood behind Tazri's proposal.

entities.name: Kesenya
entities.description: Veteran explorer who leads the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.

entities.name: Sea Gate Expeditionary House
entities.description: A new expeditionary house formed from adventurers who breached Emeria, exploring the Skyclaves; secretly backed by Nahiri.

entities.name: Thada Adel
entities.description: Knowledgeable former adventurer who leads Tikal Harborage.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: The restless, shifting landscape of Zendikar.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Phyrexian incursion tool whose arrival Nahiri facilitated on Zendikar.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion that targeted Zendikar.

entities.name: Tikal Harborage
entities.description: A half-submerged merfolk outpost upriver from Sea Gate where mages use hedrons to study and contain Eldrazi threats.

entities.name: Oran-Rief
entities.description: A gigantic reef-rock forest dominating Tazeem's interior, blighted by Ulamog.

events.summary: The archangel Iona destroys the Tazeem Skyclave, ending the Makindi reign and creating Emeria.
events.quote: The Makindi reign ended when the archangel Iona destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave

events.summary: Within two years of the Eldrazi's release, Sea Gate is overrun and destroyed, Oran-Rief dies and Halimar is emptied.
events.quote: Within two years of the release of the Eldrazi, Sea Gate was overrun and destroyed.

events.summary: The Gatewatch is formed on a cliffside overlooking Sea Gate.
events.quote: The formation of the Gatewatch occurred on Tazeem

events.summary: After the Eldrazi fall, Commander Tazri drafts a rebuilding plan backed by Linvala and Sea Gate is restored within a year.
events.quote: Within a year, the city was restored.

events.summary: Adventurers ascend through Emeria, discover the Skyclave remnants and awaken the other six Skyclaves.
events.quote: they triggered the magical defenses of the ancient Skyclave

events.summary: The adventurers who breached Emeria form the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, secretly backed by Nahiri.
Nissa Revane uses the Lithoform Core's healing power, accelerating the continent's recovery.
events.quote: the recovery of the continent was accelerated

events.summary: Compleated Nahiri arrives at the Emeria Skyclave and realigns hedrons to facilitate Realmbreaker's incursion; the Roil rises against her and is defeated.
events.quote: began realigning the plane's hedrons to facilitate Realmbreaker's incursion into the plane

events.summary: Phyrexians pour into Zendikar and Sea Gate is defeated once more.
events.quote: As Phyrexians poured into Zendikar, Sea Gate was defeated once more.

relations.quote: Tazeem is one of the seven continents of Zendikar
The largest city on the continent
The leader of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House is the veteran explorer Kesenya

relations.note: Former adventurer in charge of the outpost.
relations.quote: the knowledgeable former adventurer Thada Adel

relations.note: Secret benefactor searching for artifacts to counteract the Roil.

relations.quote: This vastwood was blighted by Ulamog.
